flow: Vaccinated Monitored Children (MVC)->Vaccinated Adults (Catch-up Program, VA)
param: β_C Infection (transmission) rate for fully susceptible children becoming infected
ε Vaccine failure factor for un-monitored vaccinated children; infection occurs at rate εβ_C where (1-ε) is vaccine effectiveness
β_A Infection (transmission) rate for adults (assumed low among adults)
h_M Rate of immunization of the Monitored Vaccination Group (children) to become non-susceptible
h_A Rate of immunization of the Adult Vaccination Group to become non-susceptible (set to 0 in Nepal fitting period)
x_U Vaccination/enrollment rate into Un-monitored vaccination group (estimated in data fitting; symbol mentioned in sensitivity list)
x_M Vaccination/enrollment rate into Monitored vaccination group (symbol mentioned in sensitivity list and adult-child vaccination plane)
x_A Adult catch-up vaccination rate (set to 0 in Nepal fitting period)
j Maturation rate from children (≤15) to adults (>15)
d Progression rate from exposed to infectious (incubation ~10 days)
g Recovery rate from infectious (recovery period ~15 days)
q Case reporting/observation factor used in weekly incidence: h(t)=q*d*E(t) (symbol appears in numerical fitting description)
